Dog Rescue TV is your home on YouTube for dog rescues from partners of the World Animal Awareness Society & World Animal Rescue Network from around the world. 

Videos from the World Animal Awareness Society are produced in the field and in our post production facilities using state of the art cameras, technology and more than 20 years of experience releasing content about humans rescuing animals.  #WA2SFilms has directly captured stories with over 2,200 NGO's and government organizations around the world. We use new state of the art a i to script, automate, paint, sing our stories to life. Tools that allow us to support animal rescues around the world. In the past five years the WA2S has donated more than $500,000 to animal rescuers.  We are the World Animal Awareness Society, World Animal Rescue Network and WA2S Films. We are about animals being rescued and the people doing the rescues...

To donate: https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=ZEXBJW3E8RPW2
